loginSubtitle: जारी रखने के लिए साइन इन करें
mfaSetupLead: जारी रखने के लिए प्रमाणक ऐप सेट करें।
mfaVerifyLead: अपने प्रमाणक ऐप से कोड दर्ज करें।
mfaEnableAndSignIn: सक्षम करें और साइन इन करें
geoStatesLead: Browse providers and job stats by Indian state, then drill into districts.
geoDistrictsLead: Districts in this state with provider counts and job outcomes.
geoProvidersLead: Providers assigned to this district. Create a new provider here or assign an existing one.
geoAddProviderLead: New provider will be placed in {{district}}, {{state}}.
geoNoProvidersToAssign: No other providers available to assign. Create a new one instead.
actAsSuperAdminLead: Enter the 4-digit Super Admin key to add or remove admin accounts.
updateSuperAdminKeyLead: Only someone with the current key can change it.
superAdminRequired: Act as Super Admin first to manage admin accounts.
superAdminRequiredPinPassword: Act as Super Admin to reset an admin's MFA or password.
pinRevealFailed: PIN could not be revealed. Reset the PIN to create a recoverable one.
clientsLead: Manage white-label clients, product names, logo, and themeColors. The active client’s branding is what Customer and Provider apps receive.
clientsLogoUrlPlaceholder: https://… or upload below after save
clientsLogoHint: Save the client first, then upload a logo image (PNG/JPG/WebP).
overviewLead: Marketplace health at a glance — pies for status mix, bars for geography and services. Pick a state to drill into districts.
overviewDetailHint: Live snapshot from the latest load. Click a stat card to focus this panel.
overviewProvidersLead: {{count}} providers on the platform by approval status.
overviewUsersMixLead: Share of registered providers and customers on the platform.
overviewProvidersPieLead: Pending, approved, and rejected providers — status you can read in one glance.
overviewJobsPieLead: How work is flowing: pending through completed and cancelled.
overviewStateBarLead: Providers, customers, and jobs compared across states.
overviewDistrictBarLead: Providers, customers, and jobs by district for the selected state.
overviewServiceBarLead: Which services have the most providers and job demand.
overviewChartEmpty: No location-tagged data yet for this view.
overviewTrendLead: Track how customers, providers, job cards, and total reach grow over time.
overviewTrendEmpty: No dated growth data in this window yet.
approvalsLead: Review pending providers and approve or reject with a reason.
addCustomerLead: Create a customer account for the customer app. Enter the 10-digit mobile number (+91 is assumed).
editCustomerLead: Update name and service address for this customer.
customerSavedDetail: Customer profile and address were updated.
addProviderLead: Create a provider with name, phone, address, and a service from your categories. Experience and rating are optional.
phoneTenDigits: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
deactivateLead: Deactivate {{name}}? They will not be able to sign in until restored.
deactivationReasonRequired: A reason is required to deactivate.
customerJobFeedbackLead: Comments left by customers on job cards assigned to this provider.
noCustomerFeedback: No customer comments on assigned jobs yet.
pinMustBeSix: PIN must be exactly 6 digits, or leave blank to auto-generate.
adminsLead: Invite admins with a shareable activation link (no email). They set a password and Google Authenticator before signing in.
addAdminLead: Enter name, email, and permissions. An activation link is returned for you to share via WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, or SMS. No email is sent.
permissionsInviteHint: All modules are selected by default. Uncheck any the admin should not access.
permissionsModulesHint: Toggle modules to grant or revoke all related capabilities.
editPermissionsLead: Update capabilities for {{name}}. Changes apply on their next login.
permissionsUpdatedDetail: {{name}} will receive the new permissions on next sign-in.
adminCreatedLead: Copy or share the activation link manually. It expires in 24 hours and can only be used once.
activationLinkCopiedDetail: Paste it into WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, or SMS.
invitationCancelledDetail: The activation link no longer works.
resetMfaLead: Clear MFA for {{name}}? On their next login they must scan a new QR and enroll again.
mfaResetDetail: {{name}} must set up authenticator again on next sign-in.
jobsLead: Open a job to view details, assign or change providers, update status, and add comments.
exportSuperAdminOnly: Elevate to Super Admin to export job cards.
assignProviderLead: Pick an approved provider for this job. Confirming sets status to accepted and notifies the customer when push is available.
changeProviderLead: Select a different approved provider, or unassign to leave the job pending.
unassignConfirm: Remove the provider from this job? Status will become unassigned.
categoriesLead: Manage categories, bilingual copy, and booking questionnaires.
categoryEditLead: Edit category details and the questions customers answer when booking.
contactsLead: Review provider contacts shared by customers and providers.
updateContactLead: Edit the recommended provider details, location, service, and status.
commentPlaceholder: Write an admin note for this job…
cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own role.
cannotDeleteOwnAccount: You cannot delete your own account.
addUserLead: Create a customer, provider, or admin account. Phone is stored as +91 and 10-digit local.
deleteUserLead: This permanently removes {{name}}. This cannot be undone.
setPasswordLead: Stored passwords are encrypted and cannot be viewed. Enter a new password for this user.
setPinLead: Enter a 6-digit PIN or leave blank to auto-generate a unique PIN.
pinUpdatedDetail: {{name}} can now sign in with phone {{phone}}. Share the PIN securely — it is shown below briefly.
pinUpdatedDetailNoPhone: {{name}} can now sign in with the PIN shown below. Share it securely.
passwordUpdatedDetail: A new password was set for {{name}}. For security, passwords cannot be viewed again after saving.
pinNotRecoverable: Set before Firebase removal — reset to view
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
name: नाम
errorGeneric: कुछ गलत हो गया। कृपया फिर प्रयास करें।
contactPrivacyLead: ग्राहकों को प्रदाता का फ़ोन नंबर दिखे या नहीं, यह यहाँ से नियंत्रित करें। हर ग्राहक API पर बैकएंड यह नीति लागू करता है।
contactPrivacyOption_ACCEPTED_ONLY: अनुरोध स्वीकार होने के बाद नंबर दिखाएँ
contactPrivacyOption_ACTIVE_REQUEST_ONLY: केवल सक्रिय अनुरोध के दौरान नंबर दिखाएँ
contactPrivacyHelp_DIRECT: ग्राहकों को ब्राउज़ और अनुरोध स्क्रीन पर वास्तविक फ़ोन नंबर दिखेगा।
contactPrivacyHelp_MASKED: ग्राहकों को वास्तविक नंबर कभी नहीं भेजा जाता।
contactPrivacyHelp_ACCEPTED_ONLY: नंबर तभी भेजा जाता है जब प्रदाता अनुरोध स्वीकार कर ले।
contactPrivacyHelp_ACTIVE_REQUEST_ONLY: नंबर केवल तब भेजा जाता है जब अनुरोध लंबित, स्वीकृत या प्रगति में हो।
contactPrivacyConfirmBody: आप बदल रहे हैं कि ग्राहकों को प्रदाता के फ़ोन नंबर कैसे दिखेंगे। जारी रखें?
contactPrivacySavedDetail: ग्राहकों को अब चुनी हुई नीति के अनुसार प्रदाता फ़ोन नंबर दिखेंगे।
contactPrivacyNoPermission: आप यह सेटिंग देख सकते हैं, लेकिन बदलने की अनुमति नहीं है।
